entities.text: Virupanna vs Chandrashekhar Nayak And Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: These three contempt petitions are filed by the respective complainants alleging disobedience of the orders passed by this Court in W.P.No.202378/2021 C/w W.P.No.201373/2021 disposed of on 22.02.2022 and W.P.No.202395/2021 disposed of on 07.02.2022.

2. The learned Single Judge was pleased to dispose of the above noted writ petitions, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, directing the concerned respondent to consider the representation given by the respective petitioners/ complainants within an outer limit of three months from the date of receipt of certified copy of the order.
3. It is alleged by the complainants that inspite of submitting the certified copy of the order passed by this Court and even after a lapse of considerable time, respondent/accused have never taken any steps in the matter to comply with the directions and not considered the representations of the complainants.
NC: 2023:KHC-K:6331-DB C/W CCC No. 200168 of 2022, CCC No. 200171 of 2022 4.

It was observed by this Court in its order dated 07.07.2023 that a perusal of the affidavit filed on 04.01.2023 shows there is partial compliance of the order in so far complaint Nos.1 to 3 are concerned and the affidavit filed on 10.03.2023 indicates the respondent authorities failed to consider the representation so far as complainant No.4 is concerned.
Hence, the respondents were directed to file a fresh affidavit/ response/ reply to show the compliance of the order insofar as the said complainant is concerned.

5. Today the learned Government Advocate has filed an affidavit of the Deputy Commissioner,
Raichur, District Raichur namely L.Chandrashekar Nayak S/o S.T.Lakshmana, along with the report of the Assistant Commissioner, Lingasugur regarding notification issued under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and the order passed by the office of the Deputy Commissioner, dated 09.08.2023.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
It is submitted by the learned Government Advocate that in addition to the earlier acquired land of 11 acres 10 guntas, a NC: 2023:KHC-K:6331-DB C/W CCC No. 200168 of 2022, CCC No. 200171 of 2022 fresh notification is issued in respect of 5 acres 03 guntas, wherein the names of left out complainants are included.
6.
In view of the affidavit filed by the Deputy Commissioner and the compliance report, the contempt proceedings are dropped.
